title: Tenma Tsukasa — Lessons With Kikyogumi〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy - Courtyard
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Tsukasa, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We didn't expect you two to arrive together, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we just happened to bump into each other.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, let's all congratulate ourselves for getting through the first day of lessons here at Morinomiya!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, what were you guys' lessons like?!
Did you all learn a lot?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, they were very educational!
As expected from the Morinomiya Music Academy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?!
What kind of lesson was it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The boys from Kikyogumi had a ballet lesson.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, so did we.
The girls from Suzurangumi also had a ballet lesson.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ballet involves learning to move your body in some very specific ways, so it may be a key piece of their program here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Though, was your lesson as intense as mine was?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure I would've been able to make it through, if we hadn't trained with Mikazukigumi...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I mean, even with my deep reservoir of stamina, it ended up being a tough test...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is ballet really that hard?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Hard may not be the right word, but I had trouble getting my body to move the way I wanted...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Raise my leg that's facing the audience, and stretch out the opposite arm...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Pretend that the mirror is the audience so that you can check to see how you're doing... How's this?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(My knee is fully straightened, but...
I'm having trouble lifting my leg any higher, and my arm isn't going much above my shoulder.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Also, it looks like my body is bending forward slightly...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hup! Hmph! Hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr! This is far from easy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ...is how that went.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know the pose you guys were doing♪ I've seen the girls on the gymnastics team do it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. You help a few other clubs out from time to time, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! So, I remember them saying how it's important to turn your pelvis the right way, use your back muscles properly, oh, and flexibility is really important too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Flexibility...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, flexibility...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We understand in theory, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Don't frown like that, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys are already pretty flexible!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we are...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we'll need to reach a new level of flexibility if we're going to do ballet. Actually, I'd say two extra levels...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm gonna be honest, the stretches we did at the start of our lesson were already really hard.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, those...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The way things stand now, my flexibility is going to be my greatest limiting factor when it comes to these ballet lessons.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The same goes for me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However! I am not about to back down from this challenge! There are techniques and forms of expression which you can only learn through doing ballet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We only get to train at Morinomiya for three months! So, we must make the absolute most of each day... No, each lesson!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm gonna do my best to learn lots and lots and lots about how they run things!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Emu, you still haven't told us about what they've been teaching you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to know as well!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we head over to SEKAI to continue our talk?
Len and Rin have been asking us about what this school is like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. Then, let's go see them!
